title: Glue-laminated timber substituted for solid timber framing: minor variation or amendment
jurisdiction: New Zealand (MBIE Chief Executive determination; Building Act 2004; comparative only, not Alberta)

facts.text: A single-storey detached house of 298 m2 with a complex shape and a low weathertightness risk score; concrete slab-on-grade with timber wall framing and roof trusses; building consent BC/0130/18 issued 16 March 2018.
Glue-laminated timber was used for wall framing and roof trusses in place of the solid timber in the approved consent, without approval being sought.
The determination considers compliance of the glulam framing and whether the substitution could be a minor variation.
